name: Cronos

bonuses.name: Lobotomized
bonuses.text: This Threat is barely sentient and acts out the will of its dark master relentlessly. It ignores abilities that target the mind and never needs to make a Resolve Test to continue fighting.

bonuses.name: Pain Engine
bonuses.text: Drukhari constructs are immune to the Blinded, Fear, Poisoned, and Terror Conditions

bonuses.name: Power From Pain: Flensing Fury
bonuses.text: If this Threat deals a Wound it gains +1 bonus dice to melee attack Tests until the end of its next Turn.

bonuses.name: Second Strike
bonuses.text: This Threat reduces the Multi-Attack penalty by 2DN, as though it had the Dual Wield Talent (Wrath & Glory, page 133).

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this Threat must make a DN 3 Fear Test.

abilities.name: Reservoir Of Pain
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to select one target with the DRUKHARI Keyword within 10m. That target recovers 1 Wound for every Wound the Cronos caused on its last Turn.
When this Threat dies, roll a d6. If you roll a Complication, the threat explodes using the following profile: 11 +4 ED / Blast (8)

determination: Insensible to Pain: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 10d6. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
note: Speed is printed "8 (Fly)". The death explosion prints no range and no weapon profile, so it stays ANNIHILATION text. Normal threat format, not the vehicle format.
